description: Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules — Multi-Stage Lateral Movement Chains

rules.name: Lateral Movement chain — RDP → Credential Access → Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects multi-stage lateral movement: initial RDP compromise followed by credential theft and data exfiltration

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — SMB → LSA Secrets → Domain Dominance
rules.description: Detects SMB lateral movement progressing to LSA secret extraction and domain controller compromise

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — SSH → Privilege Escalation → Root Access
rules.description: Detects SSH lateral movement followed by privilege escalation to root

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — WinRM → PS Remoting → Domain Controller
rules.description: Detects WinRM-based lateral movement using PowerShell remoting to reach domain controllers

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — WMI → Scheduled Task → Persistence
rules.description: Detects WMI-based lateral movement creating scheduled tasks for persistence across multiple hosts

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — DCOM → Shell Execute → C2 Callback
rules.description: Detects DCOM lateral movement followed by shell execution and command-and-control callback

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Pass-the-Hash → SMB → Domain Admin
rules.description: Detects pass-the-hash attack followed by SMB lateral movement to gain domain admin privileges

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Kerberoasting → Ticket → Service Account
rules.description: Detects Kerberoasting followed by TGS ticket usage to compromise service accounts

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Phishing → Credential Harvest → Cloud Takeover
rules.description: Detects phishing attack followed by credential harvesting and cloud service takeover

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Supply Chain → Internal Pivot → Data Staging
rules.description: Detects supply chain compromise followed by internal lateral movement and data staging for exfiltration

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Exploit → Shell → Network Propagation
rules.description: Detects exploitation followed by shell access and network propagation across multiple hosts

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — VPN → Internal Recon → Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects VPN compromise followed by internal reconnaissance and lateral movement

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — DNS Tunnel → Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects DNS tunneling followed by data exfiltration through DNS channels

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Service Account → Scheduled Task → Persistence
rules.description: Detects service account compromise followed by scheduled task creation for persistence on multiple systems

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Registry → Credential Store → Golden Ticket
rules.description: Detects registry modification followed by credential store access and golden ticket creation

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Cloud API → Resource Hijacking → Cryptomining
rules.description: Detects cloud API compromise followed by resource hijacking and cryptomining activity

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Email → Macro → PowerShell → Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects email-delivered macro followed by PowerShell execution and data exfiltration

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Zero-Day Exploit → Service Account → Domain Enum
rules.description: Detects zero-day exploit followed by service account compromise and domain enumeration

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Container Escape → Cloud Metadata → IAM Abuse
rules.description: Detects container escape followed by cloud metadata service access and IAM privilege escalation

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — IoT Device → Network Pivot → Data Access
rules.description: Detects IoT device compromise followed by network pivot to data stores

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Pass-the-Cert → AD CS → Domain Admin
rules.description: Detects certificate-based authentication abuse followed by AD CS exploitation for domain admin

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Brute Force → Account Takeover → Cloud Resource Access
rules.description: Detects brute force attack leading to account takeover and cloud resource access

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Admin Tool Abuse → Credential Dump → Lateral Spread
rules.description: Detects legitimate admin tool abuse followed by credential dumping and lateral movement across hosts

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Cloud Storage → Key Theft → Subscription Takeover
rules.description: Detects cloud storage access followed by key theft and subscription takeover

rules.name: Lateral movement chain — Supply Chain → Build Pipeline → Production Compromise
rules.description: Detects supply chain compromise progressing through build pipeline to production environment
